[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: CFR Anapu açaí dropdown option — shipped to cfr.truesight.me + beta/prod SunMint
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint_beta/pull/86
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/cfr-anapu/pull/14
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1391
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1393
  
  Details:
  **CFR Anapu (cfr.truesight.me) — açaí species option, end to end** (plan `plans/CFR_ANAPU_ACAI_UPDATE_PLAN.md` §4 item 1 + promotion).
  
  Gary: *"We need to have Acai as an option in the dropdown on this page https://cfr.truesight.me/"* → then *"sync to prod"*.
  
  **What changed**
  - Added a first-class **Açaí** species option to the SunMint tree-planting dropdown: `<option value="Açaí" data-i18n="speciesAcai">` (4th option, before *Other*) + the `speciesAcai` i18n key in **both** `pt` and `en` blocks.
  - **Source of truth** `sunmint_beta/index.html` (also live on `beta.sunmint.truesight.me`).
  - **Served vendor copy** `cfr-anapu@main` (Pages serves `main`, not `gh-pages`) — kept in sync so the next `sync_sunmint_app.py` re-vendor is a no-op.
  - **Promoted to production**: `sync_beta_to_prod(sunmint_prod)` → merge `4a627694`, ledger `deploy_20260924T172559Z_sunmint-prod`, CNAME `sunmint.truesight.me` preserved.
  - Plan tracker updated (`agentic_ai_context#1391`, `#1393`).
  
  **Why**
  - Students at CRF Anapu are now planting açaí; the shared SunMint form only named the three cacao varieties + "Other", so açaí could only be logged as free text. Naming it makes student reporting accurate.
  - **Safe / additive** (verified): downstream species capture is free text — `process_tree_planting_telegram_logs.js` → `extractSpecies()` = `/- Species: (.+)$/m`, **no allowlist**. `onSpeciesChange()` only special-cases `value === 'Other'`, so a canonical value submits unchanged. Default species stays *Cacao - Criolla*; nothing removed.
  
  **UAT ✅ (all surfaces live)**
  - `https://cfr.truesight.me/` — 5 options, Açaí 4th, `speciesAcai` in pt + en.
  - `https://beta.sunmint.truesight.me/` — Açaí option live.
  - `https://sunmint.truesight.me/` (prod) — Açaí option live (verified via no-cache origin fetch after CDN edge-cache lag).
  
  **Diagnostic note (for the audit trail)**
  - GitHub's CDN edge cache (`raw.githubusercontent.com` + the commits API, `max-age=600`) served **pre-merge bytes** for several minutes after the prod sync, giving a false "merge didn't land" signal. Ground truth was confirmed from a fresh `git clone` (prod main contains the açaí commit) and a `no-cache` origin fetch. Lesson for future prod verification: trust git objects / a no-cache fetch, not a cached API right after a push.
  
  **Pull requests**
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint_beta/pull/86 (source of truth)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/cfr-anapu/pull/14 (served copy — live)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1391 (plan tracker: §4 item 1 shipped + UAT)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1393 (plan tracker: prod promotion record)
  - Prod sync (merge commit): https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint_prod/commit/4a627694a6cc110ad5691d510bf3dfd806591469
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh, Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
